headline: Nvidia regains 952 billion dollars in market value after Jensen Huang returns as CEO
label: NEWS
caption:
Jensen Huang is back at the helm of Nvidia just weeks after his abrupt resignation. 📈

According to Al Jazeera and Dawn, Nvidia regained 952 billion dollars in market value and shares jumped 31 percent on Monday as Huang returned to the company offices. The board voted to reinstate Huang amid unprecedented pressure from United States President Donald Trump.

Nvidia previously lost 1.16 trillion dollars in market value when Huang resigned amid reports of extramarital affairs including one with an alleged Chinese spy. Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives noted that the board knew it had no choice but to bring him back.

However, Nvidia stock reversed course on Tuesday and fell more than 5 percent over reports that new tariffs on China could be on the horizon. Other semiconductor stocks like Advanced Micro Devices and Broadcom also suffered losses.
